The '''Charros system''' was located within the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros IV]]. A [[Battle of the Charros system (Mandalorian Wars)|battle]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] was fought here in [[3962 BBY]], which the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] invaders won.

It was one of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] main strongholds during the [[Thrawn campaign]] and was later invaded by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|conquest]] of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />
